verdict: CASTING-DEPENDENT / CONVERGENT (downgraded from the card's 'partial divergence'). The card is structurally honest and §9-clean: it keeps the up/down asymmetry (per-vacuum descent DOWN vs selection UP), refuses content (does not name the measure, does not derive SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1), does not assert the landscape is the substrate or that string theory is correct), cites real corroborating edges that genuinely show what is claimed (E019/E020/E009 all exist and match), and supplies a genuine, non-circular, falsifiable out-of-sample test (the two-vacuum route-mismatch/holonomy prediction not used to set the E3 tier). No content overclaim. The SHAPE -- a missing selection/measure principle ABOVE a family of per-vacuum closures, emergence-up, non-factorization -- is sound and robust across the fair castings on offer. BUT the card's headline NOVELTY, the 'partial divergence from convention' (that the selection layer must be a P2/P6 structure-supplier 'heavier than a bare re-weighting measure'), does NOT survive adversarial scrutiny: it is built on a strawman of the conventional landscape program (in which each vacuum's gauge group and generations are already outputs of its compactification, so selection already supplies them). The divergence is therefore a casting/framing artifact, motivated by wanting a result that exceeds convention; the honest reading is CONVERGENCE with the landscape+measure picture. Per the firewall rule, a motivated divergence that is really a casting artifact must be downgraded -- so the divergence is REJECTED while the (convergent) shape characterization is ACCEPTED. The P2-heaviness is also inherited from the deliberately-conservative SM casting (gauge-group/generations placed outside Sigma_f), not independently discovered. Net: a competent, disciplined, NON-field-redirecting card -- it correctly recovers and reframes the well-known landscape/vacuum-selection problem and detects the hole's shape; it does NOT deliver the novel divergence it advertises. survival 3/5: solid structure and evidence, genuine OOS test, but the headline claim is a downgraded casting artifact and one descent leg is asserted-not-computed.
